key_differences_summary: PMFBY is an agricultural risk-protection scheme (crop insurance); NSPG is an educational aid scheme (monthly stipend). PMFBY is for farmers at any age with land in notified areas; NSPG is for students under 30 pursuing first PG degree. PMFBY requires seasonal enrolment (strict cut-offs); NSPG requires annual renewal (forfeits that year only if missed). PMFBY provides variable payouts based on loss; NSPG provides fixed Rs. 15,000/month for 10 months.
recommendation: Choose PMFBY if you are a farmer needing crop loss protection. Choose NSPG if you are a meritorious, economically weaker student pursuing postgraduate studies. These schemes serve entirely different groups and cannot be compared for individual benefit—eligibility determines which applies to you. **This is AI guidance only.
